title: NU3 open-chain phosphine <-> 1,2-oxaphosphetane: verified connection

species.name: open-chain phosphine
species.native_log: runs/verify_A/.cloudra/calc-25.out.log (Opt+Freq of the GIVEN inputs/open.xyz; snapshot .cloudra/evidence/f48236db1d896e64_calc-25.out.log)
species.note: E=-496.635840 Ha reproduces the task's given minimum (inputs/open-freq.out.log, -496.635832 Ha). The separate IRC-derived endpoint re-optimized instead to a +0.70 kcal/mol OH-rotamer (E=-496.634711 Ha); that rotamer is NOT bound as the node.

species.name: 1,2-oxaphosphetane ring
species.identity: cyclic 1,2-lambda5-oxaphosphetane, 4-membered P-C-C-O ring, pentacoordinate P with 3 H
species.note: matches the task's given ring minimum inputs/ring.xyz (inputs/ring-freq.out.log, -496.585625 Ha)

steps.name: chain-to-ring direct
steps.mechanism: single concerted elementary step; hydroxyl-H migration O->P coupled to P-O ring closure

ts_mode.detail: dominated by the migrating H (atom 7); watch-pair projections O-H 0.969, P-H 0.187, P-O 0.075; heavy-atom displacement fraction 0.004

irc.forward_side: ring minimum (P-O 1.804, H on P, O-H 2.331 A) - between the TS and the ring minimum
irc.backward_side: open-chain phosphine (P-O 2.520, O-H 1.010, P-H 1.871 A) - between the TS and the given open-chain minimum
irc.proof: geometric interval proof passed: both IRC endpoint geometries lie between the TS and the corresponding verified endpoint minima; short IRC, not required to reach the minima

considered_and_rejected.evidence: no betaine stationary point: GFN2-xTB re-optimization of a genuine zwitterionic seed collapses to the ring (runs/explore/betaine_guess.out vs B_ring_Aorder.out), and neither B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP IRC direction passes through a betaine basin. The betaine species and its two candidate steps were removed from the mechanism graph.

limitations: Single electronic level B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP; ELECTRONIC energies only (no ZPE/Gibbs corrections).

Strong method sensitivity for hypervalent P: GFN2/GFN1-xTB place the ring only ~2.6 kcal/mol above the open chain vs +31.5 at B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP; semiempirical numbers must NOT be quoted as barriers (runs/explore/SUMMARY.md).

IRC was short (normal termination, 20 forward + 20 backward points) and irc_both_directions_converged=false; the direction claim rests on the geometric interval proof plus separately re-optimized, frequency-checked endpoint minima.

The TS basin on the open-chain side is the +0.70 kcal/mol OH-rotamer (E=-496.634711 Ha), not the given A (E=-496.635840 Ha); the certified node and the step's source minimum are the given A, and the barrier is referenced to it.
Gas phase, no solvent/counterion; single conformer per species; no exhaustive conformational search.
mechanism_predict (FlowER) gave a useless 1-species/1-edge network for this hypervalent-P transformation; not used as evidence.
